name: Fungal supply line

founders.label: Four linked Cordweaver segments; the first starts with 4 carbon and 0.4 nutrient (labelled setup)

labels: Labelled setup: the first segment starts with twice the ordinary body
question: How does food travel along a fungal line?
expectedObservationsText: Four Cordweaver segments in a row on a small gel bed, joined by transport links, with no food anywhere. The first starts with 4 carbon and 0.4 nutrient (a labelled setup); the others start with the ordinary 2 carbon and 0.2 nutrient. Carbon and its nutrient pass along the links from the full segment toward the others; energy never does.
